name: EPACK Prefab Technologies Ltd
tagline: Good-quality integrated PEB player, but persistent margin compression and a cut growth guide keep it a cyclical compounder, not a 10x
business_overview: Integrated turnkey pre-engineered building (PEB) and prefab-construction provider for industrial, commercial, infra and institutional projects; listed Jan 2024.
fundamentals_table: Rs 18.2 Cr, +13.4% YoY (growth lags revenue -> margin still compressing)
fundamentals_narrative: Return ratios remain good (ROE ~23%, ROCE ~24%) and the balance sheet is net cash. Q1 FY27 revenue grew 23.9% YoY, close to the revised 'minimum 20%' guide, but PAT grew only 13.4% - the four-quarter margin-compression pattern flagged earlier has not reversed. ICRA A+/A1 reaffirmed; PEB capacity now 147,122 MTPA after one Mambattu brownfield line went commercial (29 Apr 2026), Ghiloth greenfield targeted later in FY27.
sentiment_summary: No new forum activity since the prior read (thread still 7-8 live posts). Prior lukewarm 'wait and watch' tone stands; the most data-driven post documented the margin decline and steel-cost pass-through lag.
community_signal: No trusted-roster users in the thread; no high-conviction call.
key_new_facts: Sovrenn lead verified: Mambattu (AP) brownfield capacity +13,200 MT, commercial production from 29 Apr 2026, current utilisation ~60% - confirmed by the Q1 FY27 disclosure (PEB capacity now 147,122 MTPA).
Q1 FY27: revenue Rs 366 Cr (+23.9% YoY), PAT Rs 18.2 Cr (+13.4% YoY).
Order book ~Rs 1,376 Cr; net cash ~Rs 103 Cr; ICRA A+ (Stable) / A1 reaffirmed.
bull_case: High return ratios (ROE ~23%, ROCE ~24%) with a net-cash balance sheet
Structural PEB/prefab infra tailwind; capacity expansion (Mambattu live, Ghiloth coming) supports 20%+ volume growth
bear_case: PAT growth (13%) still trailing revenue growth (24%) - margin compression not yet reversed
Management cut its growth tone from 30-35% to 'minimum 20%' within a year of listing
Already a mid-cap (~Rs 2,372 Cr) at ~24x earnings - a 10x needs sustained 35%+ compounding plus multiple expansion
PEB is competitive, steel-input-sensitive and capex-cycle-linked with limited pricing power
verdict_headline: Re-verification: the Mambattu capacity datapoint holds up, but it is capacity not demand - Q1 FY27 confirms the margin-compression bear case, so 'neither' at Low conviction stands
verdict_reasoning: Re-verification stock (Sovrenn lead). The lead datapoint - Mambattu brownfield line commercial from 29 Apr 2026, ~60% utilisation - is confirmed by the Q1 FY27 disclosure, but added capacity does not change the thesis when the incremental margin is compressing.

Q1 FY27 PAT grew only 13.4% against 23.9% revenue growth - the four-quarter margin decline flagged in the prior read has not reversed; the small/mid-cap 'recent-inflection' exception still does not apply because the recent inflection is downward.
No change from the prior conviction: thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Low. Best understood as a cyclical infra-linked compounder. No red flag; no 30-day revisit.

four_box.note: Verdict explicit: Q1 FY27 'PAT grew only 13.4% against 23.9% revenue growth' - the margin decline 'has not reversed' (tailwind weak, the recent inflection is downward, not up); no moat/tam/valuation detail.
